finding: The COORD 06:38 premise (3 NESTED gate levels u_tc -> u_tt -> u_tl + u_hcg) does not hold for the kit configuration: every ICG (u_tc, u_bf.u_tt, 16 u_bf.g_l[*].u_tl) already has CLK = the core root clk port (lanes3 fclk = bf_col clk, not gclk_c) and its own registered enable copy u_ze on the root clock -> gate depth is ALREADY 1. u_hcg exists only in ot_v41_chain2u2 (lanes3 RC = 2, i.e. QBF >= 3); the kit uses QBF = 2 -> RC = 1 -> ot_v41_chain4, so no half-clock gate is elaborated. Measured root cause instead: two of the 18 ICGs each gate a whole-core domain -- u_tc 15,936 flop bits + both ROMs, u_tt 14,219 -- vs 1,284 per lane gate and 817 on the root; two deep gated trees under single ICGs (same class as qxpq_w10 u_e.g_cg 37k).
fix: RCG = 1 (ot_v41_bf_col, default 1) + TNODE (ot_v41_bf16_lanes3, default 0, bf_col passes RCG): 22 more ot_v41_tile_clk copies (7 regional column tiles + 15 tree-node tiles), each = local u_ze kreg with the identical d / clk / arst as u_tc.u_ze + local ICG on the root clock. 40 ICGs, all depth 1, max 4,549 sinks (segtree5 -- one module; further split needs a segtree5 internal change), u_tc 1,144 + 2 ROMs, u_tt 1,529. Cycle identity: every u_ze copy is the same register function of the same inputs from the same reset value, so every ICG ENA waveform is identical and every ICG (latch open while clk low, AND with clk) emits identical edges; no AND of enables is needed because no gate is nested.

evidence.sink_count: physical/die_plan/s81/core_lat/bf_col_rcg/sinks.sh + count.py (Yosys 0.67 elaboration, hierarchy -check, proc/flatten; kreg bits counted); old total 51,516, new 51,538 (+22 enable copies)
evidence.bench: physical/die_plan/s81/core_lat/bf_col_rcg/run_bench.sh + tb.cpp + rom_bench.v (Verilator 5.032): 30,000 cycles, random inputs, ze_d always-1 / 75 % / 50 % toggle phases (5k cycles each), reset pulses every 7,919 cycles; all 9 outputs every cycle: IDENTICAL (pv=1 on 3,131 cycles, 1,863 distinct pval). Run epyc1:/srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/s81-core-lat-r2/bf/bench/{old,new}/out.txt
evidence.lec: physical/die_plan/s81/core_lat/bf_col_rcg/lec_rr.sh (Yosys equiv: both sides proc/memory/flatten (keep_hierarchy unset), opt_merge -share_all canonicalisation -- merges the identical u_ze copies and then the identical ICG copies (1 ICG left on each side) -- async2sync, equiv_make/struct/simple -seq 3/induct): EQUIVALENT, 141,091 $equiv cells proven, equiv_status -assert rc 0. Run epyc2:/srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/s81-core-lat-r2/bf/lec/lec_rr.log. Caveat: the ICG is a blackbox (ICGx1 under SYNTHESIS); the proof is that the new ICG copies have identical inputs (CLK, ENA) to the old one, i.e. clock-network equivalence by structure, plus full sequential equivalence of everything else.
